blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Federated knowledge must remain usable by recipients with different modalities, private architectures, and tasks. We present FedSocket, which makes recipient execution a design requirement of the exchanged model. A shared Q combines recipient-computable inputs, task-owned outputs, and ownership-aware aggregation, connecting heterogeneous private models through a common prediction interface. Private models teach local Q copies; the returned Q supports local learning and Joint inference, with only Q parameters and counts exchanged. Across six datasets, FedSocket improves missing-modality recipient accuracy over Local by 14.44 and 15.51 percentage points on MELD and UCF-51. Under matched inference capacity, Joint exceeds independent ensembles by 11.06 points in UCF-51 accuracy and 4.87 points in mean bidirectional Flickr30k R@1. Joint also improves over Q alone on all four heterogeneous endpoints, demonstrating the value of combining local and exchanged predictions. Teacher controls, sharing-path interventions, and component factorials identify the roles of supervision, sharing, and deployment. FedSocket makes exchanged knowledge directly usable from federated training to recipient inference.
blocks.zh: 联邦知识必须被不同模式、私人结构和任务的接受者继续使用。 我们介绍FedSocket,它使得接受者执行成为交换型号的设计要求. 一个共享的Q结合了受援方-可计量的投入,任务自主的产出,以及自有意识的聚合,通过共同的预测界面将不同的私人模型连接起来. 私人模型教授本地Q复制;返回的Q支持本地学习和联合推论,只有Q参数和计数交换. 在六个数据集中,FedSocket在MELD和UCF-51上将缺失模式接收者的准确度提高14.44和15.51个百分点。 在相应的推论能力下,Joint以UCF-51精确度超过独立综艺节目11.06分,以正双向Flickr30k R@1. 联合还改善了所有四个不同终点的Q,显示了结合当地预测和交换预测的价值。 教师控制、共享途径干预和要素确定监督、共享和部署的作用。 FedSocket将交流知识从联邦培训直接用于接受者的推断。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal federated learning connects clients that differ in what they observe, how they model it, and what they predict. A video–audio donor and a video-only recipient share a task but have different inputs; an image classifier and an image–text retriever share a modality but have different outputs. Donor-only features prevent recipient execution, while incompatible task heads prevent direct output aggregation. Knowledge exchange must address both mismatches while preserving local model choice.
blocks.zh: 多式联运联合学习将不同的客户连接起来,这些客户在观察什么,如何建模,以及预测什么方面各不相同. 一个视频-音频捐赠者和一个视频唯一的接收者分担一项任务,但有不同的输入;一个图像分类器和一个图像-文本检索器共享一种模式,但产出不同。 只有捐助方的特性阻碍了受援方的执行,而互不相容的任务头则阻止了直接的产出汇总. 知识交流必须解决两种不匹配问题,同时保留本地模式选择。

blocks.en: Parameter averaging shares a common model [ 15 , 14 ] ; distillation, messenger models, and prototypes accommodate heterogeneous private models [ 12 , 25 , 26 , 22 ] . Multimodal methods address modality selection, incomplete inputs, representation exchange, and fusion [ 6 , 16 , 18 , 28 , 21 ] . These advances motivate a joint compatibility requirement: exchanged knowledge must accept available inputs, produce task-valid outputs, and support aggregation across clients. Its usefulness should persist through deployment.
blocks.zh: 平均参数共用一个通用模型[15、14];蒸馏、信使模型和原型可以容纳不同的私人模型[12、25、26、22]。 多式联运方法涉及模式选择、不完整的投入、代表交换和组合[6、16、18、28、21]。 这些进展激发了一种共同的兼容性要求:交流知识必须接受现有投入,产生任务有效的产出,支持客户之间的聚合。 它的效用应该通过部署来持续。

blocks.en: We introduce FedSocket, a recipient-executable knowledge interface realized by a shared Q model. Fixed modality mappings decouple Q from private encoders. Task-owned heads preserve classification and retrieval semantics, while a gated shared residual carries cross-task updates. Private models teach local Q copies; the server returns their aggregated knowledge for local learning and Joint prediction. Only Q parameters and counts are communicated.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了FedSocket,一个共享Q模型实现的可接收-执行的知识界面. 固定模式映射从私人编码器中去除Q. 任务所属头部保存了分类和检索语义,而一个有门的共享后遗症携带了跨任务更新. 私人模型教授本地Q拷贝;服务器返回其汇总的知识,用于本地学习和联合预测. 只传达了Q参数和计数.

blocks.en: FedSocket makes the same exchanged predictor valid across input, task, and deployment boundaries. For example, CIFAR and Flickr share image-connected parameters while retaining classification and retrieval outputs; AG and Flickr share the text path. The returned Q transfers knowledge during training and remains executable at the recipient. Across six datasets, teacher controls, path isolation, and capacity-matched alternatives separately test how Q learns, shares, and contributes to prediction.
blocks.zh: FedSocket使相同的交换预测器在输入,任务和部署边界之间有效. 例如,CIFAR和Flickr共享图像连接参数,同时保留分类和检索产出;AG和Flickr共享文本路径. 返回的Q在培训期间转让知识,在接受者仍然可以执行。 在六个数据集中,教师控制、路径隔离以及能力相匹配的替代品分别测试Q如何学习、分享和帮助预测。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Recipient-executable knowledge. We jointly specify input, output, and aggregation compatibility, enabling shared prediction across heterogeneous modalities, private architectures, and tasks. • Task-valid sharing from training to deployment. Q separates task-owned prediction blocks from gated cross-task residuals, learns from private models, and returns for local teaching and inference. Path isolation tests the shared connection. • Controlled gains across six datasets. Capacity-matched alternatives establish deployment value; teacher and component controls identify learning and sharing effects, complemented by backbone and partition analyses.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: 我们共同规定了投入、产出和汇总的相容性,从而能够在各种模式、私人结构和任务之间作出共同的预测。 • 从培训到部署任务有实效的共享。 Q将任务自有的预测块从有门的跨任务剩余物中分出来,从私人模型中学习,返回当地教学和推论. 路径隔离测试共享连接 。 • 控制了六个数据集的收益。 与能力相匹配的替代办法确定部署价值;教师和组成部分控制确定学习和分享效果,辅以骨干和分区分析。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: FedAvg aggregates a shared model, and FedProx stabilizes local optimization under statistical and systems heterogeneity [ 15 , 14 ] . Knowledge distillation transfers predictions between models [ 11 ] , allowing architectures to differ. FedMD uses predictions on common public examples [ 12 ] ; FedGEMS selectively fuses client knowledge for a larger server model, and FedET uses heterogeneous ensembles [ 4 , 5 ] . FedProto exchanges class prototypes to regularize local models [ 22 ] . These approaches provide different exchange objects with corresponding input, output, and representation requirements.
blocks.zh: FedAvg聚合了一个共享模型,FedProx在统计和系统异质性下稳定了局部优化[15,14]. 知识分馏在模型之间转移了预测[11],允许架构的差异. FedMD使用对常见的公有实例的预测[12];FedGEMS有选择地将客户端知识导出一个更大的服务器模型,FedET使用相异的综艺[4,5]. FedProto交换类原型,使本地型号规范化[22]. 这些方法为不同的交换对象提供了相应的投入,产出和表示要求.

blocks.en: FML retains personalized models while aggregating a mutually distilled meme model [ 19 ] ; FedKD shares a small mentee trained with local mentors through adaptive mutual distillation and compressed updates [ 25 ] . MH-pFLID uses a public-data-free messenger with receiver and transmitter modules for heterogeneous private architectures [ 26 ] . FedSocket builds on shared-model exchange by coupling recipient computation with parameter ownership: classifiers and retrievers share compatible Q blocks while retaining task-valid outputs, and recipients reuse the returned Q in Joint inference. This coupled interface is the focus of our contribution. Table 14 compares exchange requirements and evaluated deployments.
blocks.zh: FML保留了个性化模型,同时汇总出一个相互分馏的meme模型[19];FedKD通过适应性的相互分馏和压缩更新来分享一个与当地导师一起训练的小型元件. [25]. MH-pFLID使用无公用数据信使,并带有接收器和发报器模块,用于异质的私人架构 [26]. FedSocket基于共享-模型交换,将接收者计算与参数所有权相配合:分类者和检索者共享相容的Q块,同时保留任务验证输出,接收者在联合推断中再用返回的Q. 这种结合的界面是我们的贡献的重点。 表14比较了外汇需求和评价的部署情况。

blocks.en: FedMultimodal benchmarks modality heterogeneity [ 8 ] . FedMSplit adapts multimodal multi-task collaboration to heterogeneous active sensors, while Harmony disentangles multimodal training to exploit modality heterogeneity [ 2 , 16 ] . MFedMC and BMSFed select clients or modality components to control communication and modality bias [ 30 , 6 ] . Federated prompt tuning aligns instructions under heterogeneous and incomplete multimodal inputs [ 18 ] ; ModalityMirror and TACTFL transfer or align information under missing modalities [ 9 , 20 ] . FedSocket instead makes the exchanged predictor itself executable after aggregation across private architectures and task outputs.
blocks.zh: 多式联运基准模式的异同性 [8]. FedMSplit使多模式多任务协作适应多功能活性传感器,而和谐则分散多模式训练以利用模式异性[2,16]. MFedMC和BMSFed选择客户端或模式组件来控制通信和模式偏差[30,6]. 联邦迅速调整在多种和不完整的多式联运投入下的指示[18];模式 镜像和TACTFL在缺失模式下传输或调整信息 [9, 20]. FedSocket转而使交换的预测器在组合到私人架构和任务输出后本身可以执行.

blocks.en: CreamFL uses public image–text representations to bridge model, modality, and task gaps [ 28 ] . FedHTCM couples cross-modal distillation with task-conflict handling [ 27 ] ; FedAMB addresses modality dominance through adaptive distillation [ 10 ] ; FedAFD combines alignment, adversarial fusion, and distillation [ 21 ] . FedSocket exchanges compatible Q parameters while retaining classification and retrieval heads within their owning tasks. Image/text isolation measures the utility of the resulting shared paths.

blocks.en: FedSocket assigns compatibility to the exchanged model. Common modality mappings make its inputs available to recipients, task-owned branches preserve valid outputs, and shared blocks carry updates between related tasks. Q can therefore move through local teaching, server aggregation, and recipient deployment without changing private architectures. The conditional target and label anchoring describe the knowledge available through the recipient interface ( Eqs. 1 and 28 ).

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: FedSocket makes federated knowledge executable at the recipient. Its shared Q combines computable inputs, task-owned outputs, and compatible aggregation, allowing heterogeneous private models to teach a common predictor and reuse it during learning and inference. Across six datasets, recipient gains, shared-path interventions, and capacity-matched alternatives demonstrate the value of this design for classification and retrieval. Private, Q, and Joint expose distinct deployment choices, while component studies connect training decisions to their outcomes. FedSocket thus connects federation and deployment through an exchanged model that recipients can use directly.
blocks.zh: FedSocket使联邦知识可以在接受者处被执行. 其共享的Q结合了可计算投入,任务自主产出和相容的聚合,允许不同的私人模型教授一个共同的预测器,并在学习和推论中再用. 在六个数据集中,受援国的收益、共同途径干预措施以及能力相匹配的替代品都显示了这种设计对分类和检索的价值。 私人、Q和联合披露不同的部署选择,而组成部分研究则将培训决定与结果联系起来。 FedSocket因此通过一个可以直接使用的交换模式连接了联邦和部署.
